recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. Future SupplyDelivery.receiver changes should be made in HL7/oo-incubator rather than inactive core SupplyDelivery files.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 OO change request to add Organization to the SupplyDelivery.receiver reference targets and align the receiver description with the individual-or-organization wording.
initial_application: Jira cites commit fbd31739bfe479a3c2172cdb1ea21e805f2691b1, which added Organization to SupplyDelivery.receiver and changed the definition from person-or-organization to individual-or-organization in source/supplydelivery/structuredefinition-SupplyDelivery.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-41414 later intentionally broadened SupplyDelivery.receiver for R6 by adding Group and the Group-use comment. Commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 then removed SupplyDelivery from active core fhir.ini entries and redirected core references to the OO Incubator IG. The current OO Incubator StructureDefinition JSON includes Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Organization, and Group for SupplyDelivery.receiver.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit and made no source changes because SupplyDelivery is no longer an active core resource in this checkout, while the external current artifact already preserves the requested Organization target.
